k: 11,409 settlers entered al-aqsa during jewish holiday season, governorate says the jerusalem governorate said entries through the maghariba gate during the autumn holidays took the year's total past 52,000. al-aqsa mosque compound, old city jerusalem jerusalem al-aqsa holidays maghariba gate dozens of settlers entered the al-aqsa mosque compound through the maghariba gate during the morning and afternoon visiting periods on monday, 5 october, under the protection of israeli police, the qatar news agency reported from occupied jerusalem. israeli police escorted the groups. the jerusalem governorate said 11,409 settlers entered the compound during the jewish holiday season and 52,277 since the start of the year. it said public prayers and rituals were held in the courtyards during the season under police guard. palestinian media counted 174 entries on 4 october alone. palestinian officials say police-protected prayers in the courtyards are changing the status quo at the site, which covers 144 dunams. egypt's foreign ministry condemned settler rituals inside the compound on 1 october. the figures come from palestinian bodies and were not confirmed by israeli police.

h: Hebron detainee dies at Ofer after nearly a year held without charge
d: Moataz al-Atrash, 21, had no known health problems before his arrest, his family says; his death raised the wartime toll to 92.
k: hebron detainee dies at ofer after nearly a year held without charge moataz al-atrash, 21, had no known health problems before his arrest, his family says; his death raised the wartime toll to 92. ofer prison west bank prisoners deaths in custody administrative detention hebron ofer moataz al-atrash, a 21-year-old from hebron, died at ofer prison in mid-september after almost a year in administrative detention, the commission of detainees' affairs and the prisoners' society said. his family said they were told only that he had died in prison, and that legal records showed no health conditions before his arrest. haaretz reported that his death brought to 92 the number of palestinian detainees who have died in israeli prisons since the war began. a report by prisoner groups on 8 october said six had died since the start of 2026. counts differ: israeli authorities have identified fewer, and haaretz earlier cited higher totals for security prisoners. no cause of death has been made public. in august, the israel prison service informed the detainees' commission of the death of ihab diab, 36, whom the commission believes died nearly two years earlier. administrative detention allows israel to hold people without charge or trial.
